changes: On the moon the sky is space: black, the stars out by day, the sun white; the sky is now space with home's day as a layer of its air, fading as you climb.
Approaching the moon you see its real cratered surface up close instead of a flat disc, and it stays under the ground as you land.
Crossing onto or off the moon, the view eases upright instead of turning at once.
On the moon the map is hidden with a note (home's map shows home only).
